def: A pie made of apples (usually sliced or stewed) with spice andsugar. Apple-pie bed, a bed in which, as a joke, the sheets are sodoubled (like the cover of an apple turnover) as to prevent any onefrom getting at his length between them. Halliwell, Conybeare.-- Apple-pie order, perfect order or arrangement. [Colloq.]Halliwell.
A card, die. or domino, having four spots, or pips
Dejected; sorrowful; downcast. [Obs.] "So piteous and so maat."Chaucer.
A bond or pledge for appearance before a judge on a certainday. [Obs.]
A patient who receives lodging and food, as well as treatment,in a hospital or an infirmary; -- distinguished from outpatient.
A purse or purse net. B. Jonson.
Of well being; of formal sufficiency for the time;conditionally; provisionally. Abbott.
One who has lost his hair by disease; a sneaking fellow, or onewho is hardly used.
